slark_essence_shift.name: Essence Shift
slark_essence_shift.description: Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining %stat_loss% of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus %agi_gain% Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals %agi_gain% Agility.
slark_essence_shift.lore: With each strike at his adversaries, Slark's knowledge of their weaknesses improves.
slark_essence_shift.note0: To permanently steal Agility, Slark doesn't need to land the killing blow, as long as the enemy hero is killed within 300 range of Slark while having the Essence Shift debuff.
slark_essence_shift.note1: Essence Shifted stats are returned to normal on death. The stat return for Slark and for the affected hero are separate.
slark_essence_shift.note2: To permanently steal Agility, Slark doesn't need to land the killing blow, as long as the enemy hero is killed within Slark's Steal Radius while having the Essence Shift debuff.
slark_essence_shift.note3: Break disables the gaining of temporary stacks. Does not disable the gaining of permanent stacks.
slark_essence_shift.note4: Break does not disable the bonuses of existing stacks.

slark_dark_pact.name: Dark Pact
slark_dark_pact.description: After a short delay, Slark sacrifices some of his life blood, purging most negative debuffs and dealing damage to enemy units around him and to himself.  Slark only takes %self_damage_pct%%% of the damage.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
slark_dark_pact.lore: Slithereen are capable of quickly regrowing appendages, in case of critical injury, to save their own lives.
slark_dark_pact.note0: %delay% seconds after cast, a series of %total_pulses% pulses separated by %pulse_interval% seconds deal the damage.
slark_dark_pact.note1: Each pulse also removes debuffs from Slark.
slark_dark_pact.note2: You can't kill yourself with this skill.
slark_dark_pact.note3: The pulses stop if Slark dies.

slark_pounce.name: Pounce
slark_pounce.description: Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects. That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.
slark_pounce.facet_slark_leeching_leash: Pounce applies stacks of Essence Shift when striking enemy heroes.
slark_pounce.lore: Time in the Dark Reef made Slark a dangerous assassin; aggressive and fearless.
slark_pounce.note0: On cast, Slark leaps forward at a speed of %pounce_speed%, stopping when he latches onto an enemy hero or has traveled %pounce_distance% distance.
slark_pounce.note1: Spell Immune units cannot be leashed.
slark_pounce.note2: Trees will be destroyed around Slark's landing location.

slark_saltwater_shiv.name: Saltwater Shiv
slark_saltwater_shiv.description:
Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.

These effects stack independently.

slark_shadow_dance.name: Shadow Dance
slark_shadow_dance.description:
When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration.  If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for %neutral_disable% seconds.

When activated, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark, but enemies can see the cloud itself.
slark_shadow_dance.lore: The hidden Thirteenth is a slippery foe.
slark_shadow_dance.note0: If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for %neutral_disable% seconds.
slark_shadow_dance.note1: The passive movement and health regeneration bonuses have a %activation_delay% second activation and deactivation delay.
